name: Founding Dev
description_en:
Founding.dev combines ready-made business applications, AI customization and an engineer-assisted custom-build option. Its current site emphasizes replacing rented SaaS with software the customer can own, rather than only generating code suggestions inside an IDE.

Two routes need separate evaluation: adapting a template through the builder, or agreeing a custom scope with engineers. The website’s ownership and maintenance promises should be checked against the specific export, hosting and support contract before replacing an operational system.
description_zh:
Founding.dev 结合现成业务应用、AI 定制及工程师参与的自定义开发。当前官网强调用客户可拥有的软件替代租用 SaaS，而不只是 IDE 内生成代码建议。

两条路径需分别评估：通过构建器修改模板，或与工程师约定定制范围。替代运营系统前，应将官网所有权和维护承诺与具体导出、托管及支持合同核对。

sections.title_zh: 从有限业务任务开始替换
sections.en:
The template route is to select an existing app, change it using AI and launch. The custom route starts with a scope/pricing call, an engineer-built foundation and continued engineering support. Template names such as CRM or scheduling indicate starting points, not verified parity with every feature in the SaaS named on the page.

For a hypothetical CRM pilot, import a few non-sensitive contacts, define one status transition and test permissions, export and recovery before migrating the full database. A generated screen or a vendor case study does not establish correct customer-data migration or production readiness. No app, migration or support interaction was tested here.
sections.zh:
模板路线为选择现有应用、用 AI 更改并推出；定制路线先沟通范围／价格，由工程师搭基础并继续支持。CRM、预约等模板名表示起点，不能证明与网页列举的 SaaS 全功能一致。

假设 CRM 试点可导入少量非敏感联系人，定义一次状态变更，并在迁移全部数据库前测试权限、导出和恢复。生成页面或厂商案例不能证明客户数据迁移正确或已适合生产。本文未测试应用、迁移或支持交互。

sections.title_en: Builder credit and app hosting are separate
sections.title_zh: 构建额度与应用托管另计
sections.en:
The pricing page lists Unlock at USD 19/month with six active apps and one replacement template, Unleash at USD 59 with eighteen apps and three templates, and custom Business. Paid building credit refreshes monthly, unused credit rolls over and top-ups are available. The page does not state the exact numeric credit allocation for every tier.

Publishing a full-stack app separately costs USD 9/month if it may sleep or USD 18 if always on; landing pages can publish free and Business includes always-on hosting. Thus an illustrative Unlock account with two sleeping full-stack apps costs USD 37/month before top-ups, taxes or other services. The Free account’s building credit lasts thirty days; do not describe it as unlimited ongoing free AI development.
sections.zh:
价格页列 Unlock 月付 19 美元，六个活跃应用、一个替换模板；Unleash 月付 59，十八应用、三个模板；Business 定制。付费构建额度每月补充，未用可结转并能加购，但页面未给每档完整数字额度。

发布全栈应用另收每应用每月 9 美元（可休眠）或 18 美元（常驻）；落地页可免费发布，Business 含常驻托管。因此假设 Unlock 加两个可休眠全栈应用，月费为 37 美元，未含加购、税费或其他服务。Free 账户的构建额度仅三十天，不能描述为无限持续免费 AI 开发。

sections.title_en: Verify the exit path and service boundaries
sections.title_zh: 验证退出路径及服务边界
sections.en:
Paid plans explicitly permit downloading code and using a custom domain. The homepage additionally claims ownership of code, data and infrastructure, and describes a one-time build plus optional maintenance arrangement. That service description differs from the builder subscription tariff; confirm which agreement covers the intended project.

Owning generated app code does not establish an open-source license for the Founding.dev platform or guarantee free hosting after cancellation. Validate database exports, dependency licenses, secrets, a reproducible build and redeployment separately. Security/compliance and no-data-loss migration statements were not audited, and no contractual SLA or exact cancellation/export behavior was verified.
sections.zh:
付费套餐明确允许下载代码和使用自定义域名。首页还主张客户拥有代码、数据和基础设施，并描述一次性开发加可选维护的安排；这与构建器订阅费率不同，应确认目标项目适用哪份协议。

拥有生成应用代码不证明 Founding.dev 平台开源，也不保证取消后免费托管。应分别验证数据库导出、依赖许可、秘密、可重复构建及重新部署。本文未审计安全／合规或无损迁移主张，未核合同 SLA 及准确取消／导出行为。
